name: Jiangsu New Vision Automotive Electronics, Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangsu New Vision Automotive Electronics, Co., Ltd engages in the research and development of head-up display solutions in China. The company's products include CyberLens, its windshield HUD (W-HUD) solution that uses windshield projection technology to display basic driving information, such asspeed, navigation directions, driving assistance alerts and media information; and CyberVision, its augmented reality HUD (AR-HUD) solution that uses algorithms and optical imaging to overlay virtual information.
